programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: In Shanghai, police are baffled by a cunning thief known as, 'The Lizard', a modern day Robin Hood who steals from the corrupt.

programme.title: Seven Warriors
programme.desc: Set in 1930s Guangxi, a group of villagers threatened by bandits hires seven warriors to stop the bandits' tyranny, and team up to defeat the bandits in the end.

programme.title: 3AM The Campsite
programme.desc: A group of friends going on a camping trip inside a haunted forest encounters a series of paranormal events. When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Rebellious Na Cha kills the Dragon King's son, sparking divine wrath. After a sacrifice, he is reborn more powerful than ever and rises to fight for justice.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan.

programme.title: Iceman Cometh
programme.desc: While a royal guard pursues an evil rapist, they are accidentally frozen. Thawed out to modern-day Hong Kong, the pursuit to uphold justice continues.

programme.title: Guns & Roses
programme.desc: Jin Shui risks everything to save his family, fleeing France with the help of his friend. Amid challenges, Jin Shui faces a dilemma: love or loyalty to his friend.

programme.title: Return Of The Lucky Stars
programme.desc: Four orphaned buddies open a detective agency and before they know it, they are coerced into taking on some vicious gangsters.

programme.title: Colour of the Loyalty
programme.desc: A triad boss' elite guards are tasked with protecting him from assassination. As one guard witnesses the elimination of other triad bosses, he unravels a huge conspiracy.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: A kung-fu master must take on a venal drug-smuggling gang. Representing the Book of Revelation's four riders, the heroes fight against murder, corruption, jealousy and greed.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Dr Lam diagnoses the latest phenomenon as more citizens become 'infected'. He decides to stop the vampires from turning more citizens.

programme.title: Widow Warriors
programme.desc: When the men in a triad family are betrayed and gunned down by a rival gang, their wives decide to take revenge for the death of their husbands.

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: In 1933, during the Defence of the Great Wall, seven Chinese soldiers defend the outpost of Badaolouzi against overwhelming Japanese forces in a heroic last stand.

programme.title: The Tigers
programme.desc: Five cops find their careers and their lives in jeopardy when they accept a 10 million dollar bribe from a drug smuggler, to release him from custody during a drug bust.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The film pays tribute to generations of stuntmen, including current super stars, who designed and delivered some of the most spectacular death-defying kung fu moves on-screen.

programme.title: Kungfu Cyborg: Metallic Attraction
programme.desc: An advanced cyborg cop is created as a crime fighter for the villagers in 2046. It can overcome most challenges except for love and battling a rogue cyborg.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man is forced to leave home and work to support his family by teaching martial arts skills for self-defense.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: A bitter princess kills a man and his mistress and separates their twin babies. One is raised by villains, and the other is raised by her to unknowingly kill his own brother.

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: A newly-married man leaves on a three-year mission to deliver something to the capital.

programme.title: Gun N' Rose
programme.desc: A Taiwanese gang boss names his adopted son Long Yi as his successor. This provokes Long Er (his biological son) to murder his father. Long Yi must now confront Long Er in a final battle.

programme.title: The Sniper
programme.desc: A police sniper teams up with a hot-headed rookie to take down his former friend and teammate who is exacting revenge on the police.

programme.title: Confession Of Pain
programme.desc: After Detective Hei's father-in-law is murdered, his wife enlists the help of private detective Bong to uncover the truth, which may be linked to Hei.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong in 1917. When the whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition, Ip Man decides to step up.

programme.title: Wild Search
programme.desc: In a gun trafficking raid, a police officer finds the little girl who witnessed her mother's murder by the ruthless gunrunners, and must protect her from being killed.

programme.title: The Moon Warrior
programme.desc: A benevolent fisherman living a simple life is reluctantly drawn into helping a noble emperor regain his throne from his evil brother.

programme.title: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: Constable Zhan Zhao is constantly at loggerheads with Bai Yu Tong. Unbeknownst to Zhan, Bai is a girl subtly vying for his heart amidst their escalating conflicts.

programme.title: Model Family
programme.desc: Yu Xiang and Tong Tong move into a new neighbourhood where everyone's life seems perfect. Dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really is as it seems.

programme.title: Holy Flame Of The Martial World
programme.desc: A popular tale of a brother and sister seeking vengeance for the death of their parents through the mythical yin/yang holy flame technique is a visual epic.

programme.title: My Heart is That Eternal Rose
programme.desc: A professional killer reunites with his ex-lover who has become the mistress of a kingpin, leading them into extreme danger.
